examples.question_text: The ordered scores are $12,17,19,22,25,28,31,35,x$. The last score is the maximum, and the range is $30$. Find the missing maximum and state the five-number summary.
examples.solution_text:
The maximum is the minimum plus the range.
$\begin{aligned}x&=12+30\\&=42\end{aligned}$
The full ordered list is $12,17,19,22,25,28,31,35,42$.
The median is the fifth value, $25$. Disregard it when finding the quartiles.
The lower half is $12,17,19,22$; the upper half is $28,31,35,42$.
$\begin{aligned}Q_1&=\frac{17+19}{2}\\&=18\end{aligned}$
$\begin{aligned}Q_3&=\frac{31+35}{2}\\&=33\end{aligned}$
Five-number summary: minimum $=12$, $Q_1=18$, median $=25$, $Q_3=33$, maximum $=42$.

examples.derivation: The axis uses score coordinates directly. Whisker ends are 12 and 47, box edges are 18 and 39, and the median line is 27. The five-number summary is therefore 12, 18, 27, 39, 47; range = 47 − 12 = 35. Solution annotations match those coordinates. The phantom equals gutter preserves the calculation.

The completed plot has whisker ends at 9 and 43, box edges at 16 and 31, and median line at 24. Its coordinates and solution annotations match every given. The question contains only the givens and blank scaled axis. Construction follows the supplied booklet method and preserves the existing example's mathematics.

The box edges are 14 and 37; the right whisker ends at 49, so its length is 49 − 37 = 12. The median line is at 18. A median describes ordered position and need not bisect the box geometrically. Solution annotations match the question diagram, and the phantom equals gutter preserves the subtraction.

Maximum = 12 + 30 = 42. The completed ordered dataset has nine values, so its fifth value, 25, is the median. Excluding it gives lower half 12, 17, 19, 22 and upper half 28, 31, 35, 42. Q1 = (17 + 19)/2 = 18 and Q3 = (31 + 35)/2 = 33. The five-number summary is 12, 18, 25, 33, 42. This adapts the supplied missing-maximum exercise using different values and the taught quartile method. No diagram is necessary.
